What the mathematics establishes

Exact checks, with explicit limits.

The structural examples below use synthetic 24 m and 12 m geometry. Changing the map selection does not turn them into a site-specific bridge design.

Two idealized structural states

TensionCompressionDashed: undeformed geometry

Axial, pin-jointed, small-displacement model. No member buckling, physical connector capacity, mast flexibility, lateral stability, vibration or validated transition between these states.

Support feasibility over the extension path

Declared combinations retain a strict vertical-contact feasibility margin throughout the prescribed path and horizontal-force bounds.

Resultant lies inside the
convex polygon of coplanar pads.

The exact truss solve can certify rank and equilibrium for its inputs. The support-polygon check asks whether nonnegative vertical reactions can exist; it does not calculate the reaction split among flexible pads.

Weights, center-of-gravity motion, ballast and forces are assumed. Bearing pressure, settlement, sliding, three-dimensional frame behavior and actual component capacity remain open.
